keyVerseDR: "Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths." (Mt 3:3)

level1.title: Prepare the Way
level1.story: John the Baptist lived in the desert. He wore camel hair and ate locusts and honey. He said, "Get ready! Jesus is coming!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did John tell the people?
What can you clean up in your heart?
actions: Say sorry when I am wrong
level1.prayer: Jesus, help me make my heart ready. Amen.

activity.title: Purple for Advent
activity.intro: Advent's color is violet. Find 3 purple things at home.

level2.title: A Voice in the Desert
level2.story: John the Baptist preached in the desert of Judea, saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand!" He wore camel hair and ate locusts and wild honey. Crowds came to the Jordan River to confess their sins and be baptized. John said, "Prepare the way of the Lord, make His paths straight." He told them that someone mightier was coming who would baptize with the Holy Spirit.
level2.keyLine: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does it mean to repent?
What is one 'crooked path' in your life to make straight?
actions: Go to Confession or make an examen
level2.prayer: Lord, make my heart a straight path for You. Amen.

activity.title: Prepare the way
activity.intro: John said, "Repent!" Check your heart this week.
items: Was I kind to my family?
Did I say sorry when I was wrong?

art.mainBrief: John the Baptist in camel-hair by the Jordan, pointing down a winding path
art.heartBrief: Heart drawn as a path with stones to color; footprints inside
